categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches fuzzing utilities and targets under src/test/fuzz/ and carries the Fuzzing label.
categories.rationale: Fixes misleading socket mocking in fuzz infrastructure and extends p2p socket event coverage. Previously, FuzzedSock assigned only two descriptor values, causing CConnman::SocketHandler() to 'merge wait entries of different peers... and act on one peer with the events of another,' while also failing to exercise partial events or broken connections in callers.
